method.method_draft: Read from the image that Q1 = 18, Q3 = 28.5, minimum = 2, and maximum = 33. The question asks which end must have an outlier. Instead of computing full fences, compare each outer gap to the 1.5×IQR threshold. The IQR is 28.5 - 18 = 10.5, so 1.5×IQR = 15.75. On the lower side, Q1 - minimum = 18 - 2 = 16, which is greater than 15.75, so the minimum is more than 1.5 IQRs below Q1 and must be a lower outlier. On the upper side, maximum - Q3 = 33 - 28.5 = 4.5, which is not greater than 15.75, so the upper end does not have to include an outlier.
